```{r}
# =========================================================================
# BLOOD CULTURE BOTTLE PROCUREMENT vs CONSUMPTION RECONCILIATION
# =========================================================================
# KEY ASSUMPTIONS:
#  A1. Lab extract covers the SAME period as orders (FY24/25, Apr24–Mar25).
#  A2. Hospital B "Medical Assessment Unit" == lab "Acute R & A Unit".
#  A3. Hospital A "Acute Medical Unit" == lab AMU + CAA bays (Combined Assessment Area).
#  A4. Colour model: paediatric/neonatal wards consume YELLOW (1 set = 1+ yellow);
#      adult wards (2 bottles/test) consume 1 PINK + 1 BLUE per set.
#  A5. Microbiology/Bacteriology orders = central lab stock/QC, reported SEPARATELY
#      (not ward waste).
#  A6. "Variance" = ordered − consumed = net inventory change + timing + true waste
#      + residual matching error. It is an UPPER BOUND on waste, not waste itself.
# =========================================================================

setwd("./data")
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)
library(scales)
library(readr)

orders_raw <- read_csv("Blood Culture Bottles usage 2024-25.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
lab_raw    <- read_csv("No Of Tests by Location Code and Test Name.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# =========================================================================
# HELPERS
# =========================================================================
std_hosp <- function(h) {
  h <- str_to_upper(str_squish(h))
  case_when(
    h %in% c("SITE4A", "SITE4B", "SITE4C")  ~ "SITE4",
    h %in% c("H@H", "COMMUNITY")            ~ "COMMUNITY/H@H",
    h == "SITE1/SITE2"                      ~ "LABS",
    is.na(h) | h == "NA"                    ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE                                    ~ h
  )
}

# Canonical ward key (hospital passed for context; returns KEY only)
make_ward_key <- function(hosp, ward) {
  wl    <- str_squish(str_to_lower(ward))
  wl_np <- str_squish(str_remove_all(wl, "\\(.*?\\)"))     # drop parentheticals
  num   <- str_extract(wl, "\\d+[a-z]?")                   # 118, 19a, 52 ...
  case_when(
    # ---- Site 1 named units ----
    hosp=="SITE1" & str_detect(wl,"emergency department|a&e|a & e|resus|triage|immediate care|examination a|ed pod|ed observation|gp interface|accident|major incident|\\bmiu\\b") ~ "EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT",
    hosp=="SITE1" & str_detect(wl,"acute medical|\\bamu\\b|\\bcaa\\b|combined assess")     ~ "ACUTE MEDICAL / CAA",
    hosp=="SITE1" & str_detect(wl,"surgical assess|surgical observ")                       ~ "SURGICAL ASSESSMENT",
    hosp=="SITE1" & str_detect(wl,"neonatal")                                              ~ "NEONATAL UNIT",
    hosp=="SITE1" & str_detect(wl,"labour")                                                ~ "LABOUR SUITE",
    hosp=="SITE1" & str_detect(wl,"major trauma")                                          ~ "MAJOR TRAUMA WARD",
    # ---- Site 2 named units ----
    hosp=="SITE2" & str_detect(wl,"medical assessment|acute r ?& ?a|arau")                 ~ "MEDICAL ASSESSMENT UNIT",
    hosp=="SITE2" & str_detect(wl,"surgical admission|surgical assessment")                ~ "SURGICAL ADMISSIONS UNIT",
    hosp=="SITE2" & str_detect(wl,"cancer assessment")                                     ~ "CANCER ASSESSMENT UNIT",
    hosp=="SITE2" & str_detect(wl,"\\bsdec\\b")                                            ~ "SDEC",
    # ---- Site 3 named units ----
    hosp=="SITE3" & str_detect(wl,"emergency department|emergency care|a&e|accident|\\becc\\b") ~ "A&E",
    hosp=="SITE3" & str_detect(wl,"\\bmau\\b|medical assessment|emerg.*medical|emergency medical|\\bema\\b") ~ "MEDICAL ASSESSMENT UNIT",
    hosp=="SITE3" & str_detect(wl,"intensive therapy|\\bitu\\b")                           ~ "INTENSIVE THERAPY UNIT",
    hosp=="SITE3" & str_detect(wl,"high dependency|\\bhdu\\b")                             ~ "HDU",
    hosp=="SITE3" & str_detect(wl,"labour")                                                ~ "LABOUR WARD",
    # ---- Site 4 (paediatric) named units ----
    hosp=="SITE4" & str_detect(wl,"emergency|accident")                                    ~ "EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT",
    hosp=="SITE4" & str_detect(wl,"intensive care|critical care")                          ~ "CRITICAL CARE",
    hosp=="SITE4" & str_detect(wl,"ward d1")                                                ~ "WARD D1",
    hosp=="SITE4" & str_detect(wl,"ward d2|paru")                                           ~ "WARD D2",
    hosp=="SITE4" & str_detect(wl,"ward d3")                                                ~ "WARD D3",
    hosp=="SITE4" & str_detect(wl,"ward d4")                                                ~ "WARD D4",
    hosp=="SITE4" & str_detect(wl,"ward d5")                                                ~ "WARD D5",
    # ---- Data-error rows ----
    str_detect(wl,"error|maps to two wards")                                               ~ "UNALLOCATED (DATA ERROR)",
    # ---- Numbered wards ----
    !is.na(num)                                                                            ~ paste("WARD", str_to_upper(num)),
    # ---- Fallback: cleaned name ----
    TRUE ~ str_to_upper(str_remove_all(wl_np, "[[:punct:]]"))
  )
}

# =========================================================================
# STEP 1: CLEAN ORDERS
# =========================================================================
orders_clean <- orders_raw %>%
  mutate(
    item_code      = as.character(`Ord Line Item Code`),
    qty            = as.numeric(`Ord Line Item Quantity`),
    unit_price     = parse_number(`Ord Line Item Unit price`),
    extended_price = parse_number(`Ord Line Extended Price`),
    order_date     = dmy(`Ord Date Transmitted`),
    bottle_type = case_when(
      item_code == "241989" ~ "Yellow",
      item_code == "259601" ~ "Pink",
      item_code == "259618" ~ "Blue",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    bottles_ordered = case_when(
      bottle_type == "Yellow"          ~ qty * 100,   # 2 x 50
      bottle_type %in% c("Pink","Blue")~ qty * 50,    # 1 x 50
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    cost_per_bottle = extended_price / bottles_ordered,
    is_lab_stock = str_detect(str_to_lower(Ward), "microbiology|bacteriology"),
    # DQ fix: ward mis-coded to Hospital=Unknown -> SITE2
    Hospital_fix = if_else(str_to_upper(str_squish(Hospital))=="UNKNOWN" &
                             str_detect(str_to_lower(Ward),"surgical assess"), "SITE2", Hospital),
    Hospital_std = if_else(is_lab_stock, "LABS", std_hosp(Hospital_fix)),
    ward_key     = make_ward_key(Hospital_std, Ward)
  ) %>%
  filter(bottle_type != "Unknown")          # drops trailing blank row

# =========================================================================
# STEP 2: CLEAN LAB  (+ exclusions & paediatric flag)
# =========================================================================
lab_clean <- lab_raw %>%
  mutate(
    tests   = as.numeric(`Tests receive by lab`),
    bpt     = as.numeric(`Bottles used per test`),
    bottles = as.numeric(`Total bottles received`),
    is_lab_stock = str_detect(str_to_lower(Ward), "microbiology|bacteriology"),
    Hospital_std = if_else(is_lab_stock, "LABS", std_hosp(Hospital)),
    ward_key     = make_ward_key(Hospital_std, Ward),
    is_paed = Hospital_std=="SITE4" |
      str_detect(str_to_lower(Ward),"neonatal|children|paediatric|special care baby|mother and baby|scbu")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Location != "Total", !is.na(Hospital_std),
    !Hospital_std %in% c("QA","ERROR","MISC"),
    !str_detect(str_to_lower(paste(Ward, Location)), "mds failure|not known|neqas")
  )

# =========================================================================
# STEP 3: COLOUR-LEVEL RECONCILIATION  (join-free, most robust finding)
# =========================================================================
colour_used <- lab_clean %>% filter(!is_lab_stock) %>%
  summarise(
    Yellow = sum(if_else(is_paed, bottles, 0), na.rm=TRUE),
    adult  = sum(if_else(is_paed, 0, bottles), na.rm=TRUE)
  ) %>% mutate(Pink = adult/2, Blue = adult/2) %>% select(Yellow, Pink, Blue) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to="bottle_type", values_to="used")

colour_ordered <- orders_clean %>% filter(!is_lab_stock) %>%
  group_by(bottle_type) %>% summarise(ordered = sum(bottles_ordered), .groups="drop")

colour_cost <- orders_clean %>% group_by(bottle_type) %>%
  summarise(cost_per_bottle = sum(extended_price)/sum(bottles_ordered), .groups="drop")

colour_recon <- colour_ordered %>%
  left_join(colour_used, by="bottle_type") %>%
  left_join(colour_cost, by="bottle_type") %>%
  mutate(
    variance      = ordered - used,
    order_to_use  = ordered / used,
    variance_gbp  = variance * cost_per_bottle
  )

# =========================================================================
# STEP 4: HOSPITAL-LEVEL VARIANCE  (from RAW totals -> robust to ward names)
# =========================================================================
hosp_ordered <- orders_clean %>% filter(!is_lab_stock, Hospital_std!="MISC") %>%
  group_by(Hospital_std) %>%
  summarise(bottles_ordered = sum(bottles_ordered), spend = sum(extended_price), .groups="drop")

hosp_used <- lab_clean %>% filter(!is_lab_stock) %>%
  group_by(Hospital_std) %>%
  summarise(bottles_used = sum(bottles), tests = sum(tests), .groups="drop")

hospital_variance <- full_join(hosp_ordered, hosp_used, by="Hospital_std") %>%
  replace_na(list(bottles_ordered=0, spend=0, bottles_used=0, tests=0)) %>%
  mutate(variance = bottles_ordered - bottles_used,
         order_to_use = na_if(bottles_ordered / bottles_used, Inf))

# =========================================================================
# STEP 5: WARD-LEVEL RECONCILIATION via crosswalk + MATCH-RATE KPI
# =========================================================================
weighted_cost <- with(orders_clean, sum(extended_price)/sum(bottles_ordered))  # global £/bottle

orders_ward <- orders_clean %>% filter(!is_lab_stock, Hospital_std!="MISC") %>%
  group_by(Hospital_std, ward_key) %>%
  summarise(bottles_ordered=sum(bottles_ordered), spend=sum(extended_price), .groups="drop")

lab_ward <- lab_clean %>% filter(!is_lab_stock) %>%
  group_by(Hospital_std, ward_key) %>%
  summarise(bottles_used=sum(bottles), tests=sum(tests), .groups="drop")

ward_join <- full_join(orders_ward, lab_ward, by=c("Hospital_std","ward_key")) %>%
  replace_na(list(bottles_ordered=0, spend=0, bottles_used=0, tests=0)) %>%
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      bottles_ordered>0 & bottles_used>0 ~ "Matched",
      bottles_ordered>0                  ~ "Order-only (no lab match)",
      TRUE                               ~ "Lab-only (no order match)"
    ),
    variance      = bottles_ordered - bottles_used,
    order_to_use  = na_if(bottles_ordered / bottles_used, Inf),
    variance_gbp  = variance * weighted_cost,
    Location      = paste(Hospital_std, ward_key, sep=" | ")
  )

match_rate <- ward_join %>% group_by(status) %>%
  summarise(n_wards=n(),
            bottles_ordered=sum(bottles_ordered),
            bottles_used=sum(bottles_used), .groups="drop")

pct_ordered_matched <- with(ward_join,
  sum(bottles_ordered[status=="Matched"]) / sum(bottles_ordered) * 100)

# =========================================================================
# STEP 6: PLOTS
# =========================================================================
theme_rep <- theme_minimal() + theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold"))
col_fill  <- c("Blue"="dodgerblue","Pink"="lightpink","Yellow"="gold")

# P1 – Demand: top 10 busiest wards (corrected labels)
top_demand <- lab_ward %>% slice_max(bottles_used, n=10) %>%
  mutate(Location=paste(Hospital_std, ward_key, sep=" | "))
p1 <- ggplot(top_demand, aes(reorder(Location,bottles_used), bottles_used)) +
  geom_col(fill="steelblue") + coord_flip() + scale_y_continuous(labels=comma) +
  labs(title="1. Demand: Top 10 Wards by Bottles Consumed",
       subtitle="Clinical baseline (lab-recorded usage)", x=NULL, y="Bottles used") + theme_rep

# P2 – Supply over time (DODGED, so Pink vs Blue is comparable)
monthly_orders <- orders_clean %>% filter(!is_lab_stock) %>%
  mutate(order_month=floor_date(order_date,"month")) %>%
  group_by(order_month, bottle_type) %>%
  summarise(total_bottles=sum(bottles_ordered), .groups="drop") %>% drop_na(order_month)
p2 <- ggplot(monthly_orders, aes(order_month, total_bottles, fill=bottle_type)) +
  geom_col(position="dodge") + scale_fill_manual(values=col_fill) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=comma) + scale_x_date(date_breaks="2 months", date_labels="%b %y") +
  labs(title="2. Supply: Bottles Ordered per Month by Colour",
       subtitle="Dodged bars expose Pink vs Blue balance & procurement spikes",
       x="Order month", y="Bottles ordered", fill="Bottle type") + theme_rep

# P3 – Colour reconciliation: ordered vs consumed (KEY chart)
p3 <- colour_recon %>% select(bottle_type, Ordered=ordered, Consumed=used) %>%
  pivot_longer(-bottle_type, names_to="measure", values_to="bottles") %>%
  ggplot(aes(bottle_type, bottles, fill=measure)) +
  geom_col(position="dodge") +
  geom_text(aes(label=comma(round(bottles))), position=position_dodge(0.9), vjust=-0.4, size=3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=comma) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("Ordered"="grey40","Consumed"="seagreen")) +
  labs(title="3. Colour Reconciliation: Ordered vs Consumed",
       subtitle="Yellow=paediatric; adult sets need 1 Pink + 1 Blue (should be ~equal)",
       x=NULL, y="Bottles", fill=NULL) + theme_rep

# P4 – Pink vs Blue balance over time (imbalance = guaranteed waste)
p4 <- monthly_orders %>% filter(bottle_type %in% c("Pink","Blue")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(order_month, total_bottles, fill=bottle_type)) +
  geom_col(position="dodge") + scale_fill_manual(values=col_fill) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=comma) + scale_x_date(date_breaks="2 months", date_labels="%b %y") +
  labs(title="4. Adult Set Balance: Pink vs Blue Ordered",
       subtitle="Persistent gaps cannot be used clinically -> waste of the surplus colour",
       x="Order month", y="Bottles ordered", fill="Bottle type") + theme_rep

# P5 – Price trend per bottle by colour
price_trend <- orders_clean %>% mutate(order_month=floor_date(order_date,"month")) %>%
  group_by(order_month, bottle_type) %>%
  summarise(cpb=sum(extended_price)/sum(bottles_ordered), .groups="drop") %>% drop_na(order_month)
p5 <- ggplot(price_trend, aes(order_month, cpb, colour=bottle_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth=1) + geom_point() + scale_colour_manual(values=col_fill) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=dollar_format(prefix="£")) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks="2 months", date_labels="%b %y") +
  labs(title="5. Unit Cost Trend per Bottle", subtitle="Mid-year price uplift by colour",
       x="Order month", y="Cost per bottle", colour="Bottle type") + theme_rep

# P6 – Hospital variance (net, from raw totals; can be + or -)
p6 <- hospital_variance %>% filter(bottles_ordered>0 | bottles_used>0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(reorder(Hospital_std, variance), variance, fill=variance>0)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label=comma(variance)), hjust=-0.1, size=3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=comma,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("TRUE"="coral","FALSE"="steelblue"),
                    labels=c("TRUE"="Over-supplied","FALSE"="Under-supplied"), name=NULL) +
  labs(title="6. Net Procurement Variance by Hospital",
       subtitle="Ordered − Consumed (positive = potential over-supply)",
       x=NULL, y="Net bottle variance") + theme_rep

# P7 – Pareto: matched wards with largest over-supply
top_waste <- ward_join %>% filter(status=="Matched", variance>0) %>%
  slice_max(variance_gbp, n=10)
p7 <- ggplot(top_waste, aes(reorder(Location, variance_gbp), variance_gbp)) +
  geom_col(fill="darkred", alpha=.85) + coord_flip() +
  geom_text(aes(label=dollar(variance_gbp, prefix="£", accuracy=1)), hjust=-0.1, size=3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=dollar_format(prefix="£")) +
  labs(title="7. Matched Wards: Largest Over-Supply (£)",
       subtitle="Only wards reconciled across both systems (excludes join artefacts)",
       x=NULL, y="Estimated variance value") + theme_rep +
  expand_limits(y=max(top_waste$variance_gbp)*1.2)

# P8 – Order-to-use ratio (efficiency), matched wards with material usage
top_ratio <- ward_join %>% filter(status=="Matched", bottles_used>=100) %>%
  slice_max(order_to_use, n=10)
p8 <- ggplot(top_ratio, aes(reorder(Location, order_to_use), order_to_use)) +
  geom_col(fill="orange3") + coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(yintercept=1, linetype="dashed") +
  geom_text(aes(label=scales::number(order_to_use, accuracy=0.1)), hjust=-0.1, size=3) +
  labs(title="8. Over-Ordering Index (Order ÷ Use)",
       subtitle="1.0 = perfectly matched; ≥1.3 flags over-ordering (usage ≥100 bottles)",
       x=NULL, y="Order-to-use ratio") + theme_rep + expand_limits(y=max(top_ratio$order_to_use)*1.15)

# =========================================================================
# STEP 7: SUPPORTING TABLES (spikes, lab stock, DQ register)
# =========================================================================
order_spikes <- orders_clean %>% slice_max(bottles_ordered, n=8) %>%
  select(order_date, Hospital_std, ward_key, bottle_type, qty, bottles_ordered, extended_price)

lab_stock_orders <- orders_clean %>% filter(is_lab_stock) %>%
  summarise(lines=n(), bottles=sum(bottles_ordered), spend=sum(extended_price))

dq_register <- tribble(
  ~issue, ~detail,
  "Dual-mapped ward code", "Order rows tagged to two wards -> 'UNALLOCATED (DATA ERROR)'",
  "Hospital=Unknown", "Surgical Assessment Unit orders reassigned to SITE2",
  "Lab 'Total' row", "Removed",
  "QA/NEQAS, MDS Failure, Not Known, Misc", "Excluded from clinical demand",
  "Microbiology/Bacteriology", "Treated as central lab stock; reported separately",
  "Assumption A3 (AMU=CAA)", "SITE1 Acute Medical Unit mapped to AMU+CAA bays"
)

# =========================================================================
# STEP 8: OUTPUT
# =========================================================================
print(p1); print(p2); print(p3); print(p4); print(p5); print(p6); print(p7); print(p8)

net_bottles <- sum(hospital_variance$variance)
net_gbp     <- sum(colour_recon$variance_gbp)
matched_surplus_gbp <- sum(ward_join$variance_gbp[ward_join$status=="Matched" & ward_join$variance>0])

cat("\n================= EXECUTIVE SUMMARY =================\n")
cat("Tests processed (lab):           ", comma(sum(lab_ward$tests)), "\n")
cat("Bottles consumed (lab):          ", comma(sum(lab_ward$bottles_used)), "\n")
cat("Bottles ordered (clinical):      ", comma(sum(orders_ward$bottles_ordered)), "\n")
cat("Bottles ordered (central lab):   ", comma(lab_stock_orders$bottles),
    " (£", comma(round(lab_stock_orders$spend)), ")\n", sep="")
cat("----------------------------------------------------\n")
cat("NET variance (ordered−consumed): ", comma(net_bottles),
    " bottles  |  £", comma(round(net_gbp)), "\n", sep="")
cat("  (positive = net over-supply; negative = stock drawn down)\n")
cat("Ward match rate (by ordered £/vol):", round(pct_ordered_matched,1), "% of ordered bottles reconciled\n")
cat("Matched-ward over-supply (upper bound of waste): £", comma(round(matched_surplus_gbp)), "\n", sep="")
